description: A living room coffee table vignette photographed at seated eye-level with a normal lens, framing the top surface of a dark walnut coffee table covered with a red and green plaid tartan runner. The composition focuses on the table centerpiece with the background in soft focus, revealing a deep burgundy-red upholstered sofa back, the lower branches of a decorated Christmas tree with amber fairy light sparkle, and small gift boxes in red, green, and white on the floor around the tree base. The coffee table surface holds a central showpiece — a detailed antique-bronze resin steam locomotive decorative object with textured woodgrain painted panels and dark iron-look wheels, its middle section enclosing a glass panel housing a lit snow-globe interior with a Santa Claus figure surrounded by glittery swirling confetti. The warm interior glow of the snow globe illuminates the locomotive from within, casting a soft warm halo around the piece and a gentle warmth onto the plaid runner. Scattered on the runner are small white and red miniature gift boxes. The mood is nostalgic, festive, and warmly traditional — a Christmas vignette with Victorian toy-train charm.
